Sofia (AcmePay): Hey, after the model/tool rename yesterday our production calls to the payment tool started failing with 400s. Happening for ~15% of requests. sample error: 'tool_not_found' + schema mismatch. Correlation: c-8f7a2b. Can you take a look?
Marta (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, Sofia — we're on it. Can you paste the exact request body you used and the timestamp? Also sending to raj and oncall. @Raj @Emma
Sofia (AcmePay): timestamp 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z, request body: `{"tool":"charge_customer","args":{"amount":1200,"currency":"usd","customer_id":"cus_123"}}` — note we used the old name 'charge_customer' because clients weren't updated yet.
Marta (Support): Thanks. That helps. Raj / Emma — initial thought: rename pushed yesterday from charge_customer -> charge_customer_v2 and aliases set. Maybe registry sync lag + case/canonicalization issue?
Raj (Eng: Runtime): I'll pull router logs for c-8f7a2b. Can you confirm tenant id and whether they're on Dedicated or Hosted?
Sofia (AcmePay): tenant acmepay-prod, Hosted API.
Emma (Oncall): Quick check: deploy-bot shows the registry change was merged 2026-03-16T22:05:10Z and a rolling deploy hit inference-router pool at ~22:10Z. Aliases were created in registry metadata.
Marta (Support): We also see some 404 bursts in the last 24h matching their tenant.
Raj (Eng: Runtime): Found it in router trace: request arrived and tool selector returned UUID `tool_0a1b2c_old` which no longer maps to the active schema. Selector log: `WARN tool_lookup: alias 'charge_customer' resolved to legacy handle due to cache TTL mismatch`.
Raj (Eng: Runtime): Repro note: registry change created alias record pointing charge_customer -> tool_9z8y7x_v2, but our local selector cache retained old mapping for ~5m in one pool member due to race. Also noticed alias stored with mixed-case in registry: `Charge_Customer` vs client sending `charge_customer` — our case-sensitive path didn't normalize in one code path.
Marta (Support): So combination of (1) cache sync lag across multi-AZ router pool and (2) non-normalized alias strings caused some routers to pick stale handle and then schema validation failed.
Sofia (AcmePay): Is there a workaround while you fix this? We're taking traffic hits.
Raj (Eng: Runtime): Short term options: 1) Have clients call by `tool_id` (UUID) which bypasses alias resolution, 2) call the new name `charge_customer_v2` if possible, or 3) we can trigger an immediate cache invalidation for acmepay-prod on the affected router pool. Which is easiest for you?
Sofia (AcmePay): We can push client patch but it's not instant. Could you invalidate cache so the failing 15% stops?
Emma (Oncall): I can trigger the cache purge. Running admin endpoint: `POST /admin/cache/invalidate` body `{ "tenant": "acmepay-prod", "key_prefix": "tool_alias" }` — will hit routers in ~30s.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Cache invalidation job queued (job id: j-4451), targeting router pool: inference-router-eu-1.
Raj (Eng: Runtime): After purge I see selectors returning tool_9z8y7x_v2. No more schema mismatch in live traces for that correlation id.
Marta (Support): Sofia — can you confirm if errors stop in your production after a minute?
Sofia (AcmePay): Confirmed, error rate dropped to normal. Thanks, team.
Raj (Eng: Runtime): Root causes to track: 1) alias canonicalization inconsistency (case folding not applied uniformly), 2) cache sync window allowed a brief period of stale resolution. Immediate fix: backfill normalization in registry read path and add an expedited invalidation on alias updates. Long term: make alias updates emit a pub/sub event to push syncs to routers.
Marta (Support): Filed bug ENG-1234 for the normalization + sync improvements. Assigning to eng-runtime.
Emma (Oncall): I'll also add a short-term monitor that alerts if >1% of requests for a tenant hit `tool_not_found` within a 10m window after alias changes.
Raj (Eng: Runtime): Quick patch I'll deploy: normalize aliases to lowercase on lookup and treat registry alias creation as a trigger to immediately evict key from router caches. Will open PR and sticky it to today's patch train.
Marta (Support): Follow-up: we'll notify AcmePay of mitigations and the long-term plan. Closing this thread after we see no regression for 24h. :thumbsup:
Sofia (AcmePay): Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Marta (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll update ENG-1234 with logs and the correlation ids (c-8f7a2b).
Emma (Oncall): Note for postmortem: consider making alias rename process show a 'deployment-safe' window where clients may get old mapping for up to X seconds and show it in release notes.
Raj (Eng: Runtime): Agreed. Also adding regression test to e2e suite that exercises rename + alias resolution across router pool.
Marta (Support): end of thread.
